import html # Predefined HTML template for the invitation. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_name} - Invitation
{event_name}
Date: {date_of_event}
{description_of_event}
Notes: {notes_for_event}
""" def create_invitation_for_event( event_name: str, description_of_event: str, date_of_event: str, notes_for_event: str ) -> str: """ Generates a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Args: event_name: The title of the event. description_of_event: A detailed, possibly multiline description. date_of_event: The scheduled date for the event. notes_for_event: Additional instructions or information. Returns: A string containing safe, escaped HTML ready for display. """ # Escape all user-provided inputs to prevent XSS or injection. safe_event_name = html.escape(event_name, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description_of_event, quote=True) safe_date = html.escape(date_of_event, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(notes_for_event, quote=True) # Populate the template with sanitized values. invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_name=safe_event_name, description_of_event=safe_description, date_of_event=safe_date, notes_for_event=safe_notes ) return invitation_html
